title: Bug: ViewTransition fails to animate shared elements inside RTL layouts
author: parsa-ai
body_preview: When using React's `ViewTransition` component in a Next.js application, shared element transitions do not work if the document or any ancestor element has `dir="rtl"`.  The exact same code works correctly when `dir="ltr"` is used.  As a workaround, wrapping the transition element in an ancestor with `dir="ltr"` restores the expected behavior. author: greydragon888
